text:
Elaine: Hey team — quick follow-up from the outage postmortem. We identified three actionable runbook updates (triage command ordering, eviction-check commands, and clearer escalation to infra-2). Can volunteers take ownership? Prefer owners + ETA by EoW.

Carlos: I can take the triage command ordering and submit a PR to the runbooks. ETA Thu COB. I'll include an example `kubectl` sequence and the grep checks we used.

Morgan: I'll own the eviction-check commands and add a small helper script for on-call. Will also include the caching metrics queries. Ping me for test data.

Raj: I'll take the escalation path updates (when to page infra-2 vs infra-leads and bridge procedures). Need someone to review before merging — ETA next Tue.

Elaine: @Carlos can you include the `kubectl logs --since=1h -l app=inference` snippet and the grep for OOM/alloc errors? Example block: ```bash
kubectl logs -l app/inference --since=30m | grep -i oom
``` Also add when to run `redis-cli info memory` and `curl` to health endpoints.

Carlos: Yep. Will include that exact block and a short bullet on when to escalate (e.g., sustained 95th CPU > 90% for 5m or >3 OOM events in 10m).

Morgan: For eviction checks, proposing this quick snippet: ```bash
# check eviction events in the last hour
kubectl get events --field-selector reason=Evicted --since=1h -o wide | tail -n 50
``` plus `nvidia-smi` GPU memory check and a small jq command to pull pod memory requests.

Raj: For escalation: I'll add a decision-tree: 1) Page infra on-call -> 2) If no ACK in 10m escalate to eng-sre rotation -> 3) Open incident bridge and assign triage owner. Include templates for P0 vs P1.

Elaine: Also flagged a recurring pattern tag in the doc: "cache-eviction-after-autoscaler-spike". Can we add an FAQ entry with remediation playbook: increase minReplicas / disable scale-to-zero for critical pools? @Morgan any objections?

Morgan: No objections. I'll add rationale and the HPA snippet to set `spec.minReplicas: 2` and a short note about cost tradeoffs.

Carlos: Who will review the PRs? Iirc @Sophia from eng-sre offered to help during the postmortem — Sophia can you take the reviews?

Sophia: I can review Carlos' triage PR and Raj's escalation doc. Will aim for Fri review and quick comments.

Elaine: Great — summarizing action items: Carlos (triage commands + logs snippet) — Thu COB; Morgan (eviction checks + autoscaler config + FAQ) — Fri; Raj (escalation decision tree + templates) — next Tue; Sophia (reviews) — Fri. I'll open a tracking ticket and add links to the PRs when ready. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Elaine: I'll also add a short test checklist for on-call to run after the runbook updates (verify logs, run eviction script, confirm pager routes). If anyone wants to add items, drop them here.
